Essential Qualifications:
(i) M.A. in any of the following Disciplines:
Governance and Leadership, Women’s Studies, Political Science, Public Administration, Economics,
Sociology, Commerce and Management.
(ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like
SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph. D. Degree in accordance with the University
Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree)
Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted
from NET/SLET/SET.
Honorarium:- Rs. 1500/- per lecture basis with the celing of Rs. 50, 000 per month
Note: Duly filled hard copy of the application form and template pages 1 to 11
http://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf) be submitted by
October 10, 2024 upto 04.00 p.m. in the office of Department cum Centre for Women’s Studies
and Development. Late applications will not be considered and will stand rejected. Verification of
the original documents of the candidates along with photocopies of the same will be done at the
time of interview. At the time of Interview physical Presence of the candidate is mandatory. The
candidates are required to bring all the supporting documents/certificates/publications in
original. Candidates are required to report on time on the date of interview in the Seminar Hall,
Department cum Centre for Women’s Studies and Development. The candidates are advised to
keep checking the Panjab University and online departmental noticeboard for further updates
(https://cwsd.puchd.ac.in/show-noticeboard.php?nbid=1). The candidates shall have to give an
undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any
agency till they are teaching at Department cum Centre for Women’s Studies and Development,
Panjab Universirty, Chandigarh as a Guest Faculty.
No individual intimation will be sent. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interviews.
Prof. Manvinder Kaur,
Chairperson
Dept. cum Centre for Women’s Studies and Development
